transitive_closure_law.exact_resolution: Every required strong reference must resolve to exactly one immutable object/hash/version unless producer schema explicitly authorizes lawful multiplicity/noncomparability.
transitive_closure_law.standalone_handoff: V557 handoff must carry or content-address closure so V558 can link a standalone repository without raw producer-stage lookup.
transitive_closure_law.closure_digest: Emit deterministic per-root and bundle-level closure digest over canonicalized node locators/hashes plus typed edges; serialization order never creates semantic order.
